title: API keys and webhooks
description: Manage machine access to your school's data: API keys to call endpoints, and webhooks to receive events automatically.

apiKeys.description: An API key reaches the same endpoints a session does, bounded to the permissions selected when it was created.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmBody: The key "{name}" will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.emptyBody: Create a key to give machine access to this school's data.

create.dialogBody: Choose the permissions granted to this key. They can never exceed your own account's permissions.
create.noPermissions: Your account has no permissions to grant to a key.
create.shownOnceWarning: This token is shown once. Save it now; the server only keeps its hash.
create.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically, copy it manually

webhooks.description: A webhook endpoint receives events as an HMAC-signed POST request. See docs/14-public-api.md for the verification scheme.
webhooks.deleteConfirmBody: The endpoint "{url}" will stop receiving events. This cannot be undone.
webhooks.emptyBody: Add an endpoint to receive school events automatically.

form.dialogBody: The URL must be publicly reachable; a private or loopback address is refused.

deliveries.emptyBody: Delivery history appears once the first event occurs.
